text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position in opening sentence and restated in closing","quality":"thesis control","description":"It states a consistent claim early and returns to it at the end, giving the essay a clearer argumentative throughline."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on blame, laws, and safety","quality":"organizational structure","description":"It separates its reasons into distinct body sections, which makes the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"With every car there are always things that can happen...\"","quality":"development of reasoning","description":"It explains its claims with more general reasoning instead of mostly listing dangers."},{"evidence":"\"What we do not know is how different the laws may have to be when cars become driverless\"","quality":"connection to the prompt","description":"It more directly engages the assignment's argumentative task by tying evidence to a position about whether the cars should be created."}]}
